scope.geometry: F.Cu U1 pad-to-foreign-track clearance below 90 um using native effective shapes. A strict bottleneck is recorded if the track centerline crosses the center-to-center line of two circular foreign pads for which the calculated balanced gap is below 90 um. This is a corridor bound with fixed pad diameters, center distance and track width. It does not rule out a different topology.
scope.remaining_clock_cases: Three serial records against U1.C15 on the same LPDDR4_CLKP_B escape, immediately adjacent to the C14-C15 constriction. Their segment lengths are 50.0 or 70.7 um. The minimum 90-um adjacent segment requirement in the fixed-end jog screen left no trial knot in this family. A different clock escape would require a joint clock and reference check.
scope.routing_decision: No isolated non-clock candidate remains after classifying the constrained crossings. No PCB or adoption document modified.
